abort_reason.summary: Original framing 'microservices/payroll-accounting-experience/' as a single unified µservice was incorrect per user directive 2026-05-18.
abort_reason.correct_framing: Payroll is a FULL SaaS PRODUCT and Accounting is a SEPARATE FULL SaaS PRODUCT. They live at microservices/payroll/ + microservices/accounting/ as standalone B2B SaaS products (like ADP Workforce Now + NetSuite). Payroll Specialist + Accounting Controller are ROLES WITHIN those respective products.
abort_reason.scoping_principle_violated: Per ADR-0132 (suite/bundle dissolution) the original framing collapsed two distinct concerns ('finance-close' + 'payroll-pay-run') into one µservice. ADR-0132 requires single-concern µservices; the original 'experience' framing was a bundle in disguise.

cross_product_contract_for_payroll_to_ac.doctrine_reference: feedback_workflow_objectgraph_adapter_layer.md — all inter-product adapters flow through Workflow (orchestration) + Ontology (info); products never call each other directly.
concrete_path: Payroll µservice emits journal_entry.v1 events into the workflow-engine event bus when a pay run is finalized.
Ontology projects pay_run.v1 + journal_entry.v1 entities into the ontology-projection-table.
Accounting µservice (gl-ingest BC) subscribes to the journal_entry.v1 event topic + reads ontology projection.
Reconciliation invariant: every journal_entry emitted by payroll must be ingested + acked by accounting within RPO ≤ 60s; SLO burn alarm fires on lag.
Cedar policy at accounting period-close time enforces: 'period cannot be closed if any pay run in period has un-ingested journal entries'.
Audit-chain Ed25519 seals on both sides (payroll-emit-seal + accounting-ingest-seal) form a Merkle-chain providing non-repudiation.
cross_product_contract_for_payroll_to_ac.anti_pattern_refused: Direct REST or gRPC call from accounting to payroll for journal entries is FORBIDDEN per the adapter-layer rule. Direct DB access from accounting into payroll's Citus partition is FORBIDDEN per per-microservice flat layout (ADR-0131).
